spanish: Y harás las varas maderas de shitím, y las revestirás oro.

findings.issue: The construct link is missing: the poles are of the wood, but Spanish sets varas beside maderas with no relation.
שִׁטִּים is a common noun (H7848), left as the transliteration shitím instead of Spanish.
Gold is present as the overlay material, but bare oro after revestirás las leaves that role unclear in Spanish.

notes: Y harás and the 2ms piel match; las agrees with varas and keeps the 3mp object.
